lastCompletedStory.title: Thread plan_issue into the plan-runner issue selection

nextStoryContext: US-001 added selectPlannableById and selectPlanTargetFromFile to src/issues/select.ts (target-aware selectors that never fall back to top-of-queue on a non-plannable or absent target). Also added makeReadPlanIssue to src/commands/sidecar.ts (mirrors makeReadLoopPhase pattern). makeProductionPlanPhaseFn now reads plan_issue fresh on each invocation and threads it into selectPlanTargetFromFile. The meta-loop observer (makeProductionMetaLoopObserveFn) still uses selectPlannableFromFile correctly (not a plan-phase selector). Both imports coexist in sidecar.ts. All 2684 tests pass, check:all clean. Budget raised: sidecar.ts 1020->1045.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Purely internal code: select.ts and sidecar.ts use only node:fs, node:path builtins. No new external library touched.
